ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with high-intensity (white) features occupying approximately 5-8% of the surface area, creating high localized contrast ratios.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary solid black substrate. Geometric distribution of high-contrast white circular rings and solid spots (diameters 5-15 pixels) clustered along the distal margins of both lobes. A high-intensity white amorphous cluster is visible at the extreme left tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; central depression depth is approximately 12% of the vertical lobe height with an interior pixel-angle of roughly 40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serration frequency along the entire posterior boundary; peak-to-valley pixel amplitude ranges from 4 to 12 pixels, particularly pronounced on the left lobe's inner trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward curve (positive y-axis sweep) tapering into acute, posteriorly-oriented distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely populated clusters of white circular pixel rings (10-25px) concentrated in the upper quadrants of both lobes, consistent with barnacle scar morphology.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several high-contrast vertical linear pixel streaks (~30-60px length) on the left lobe, oriented roughly perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major high-intensity white structural scarring on the far-left distal apex; numerous circular puncture-type white marks visible on the mid-to-lower sections of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A series of distinct, parallel vertical rake marks visible on the interior left lobe surface.
